name: Kisan Credit Card
benefit: Short-term farm credit at concessional interest through your bank

rules.text: Must be an owner cultivator, a tenant farmer / oral lessee / sharecropper, or a farmer doing allied activities such as animal husbandry or fisheries

documents: Land record, or tenancy / cultivation evidence as the bank requires
manual_checks: Ask the bank what evidence it accepts if you cultivate leased land (including oral lease or sharecropping)
application_steps: Visit your bank branch or cooperative society (or its official portal) and ask for a Kisan Credit Card application.
Take your land record (or tenancy / cultivation evidence if you do not own the land), bank account details, photo and ID as the bank requires.
The bank decides on credit limit; note the application number in the Applications tab.
